text: Owner reviewed the south/east/north contact sheet 2026-09-24. Verdict: tails are approved (concept correct), but there's a cross-facing inconsistency -- the south-facing candidate shows claws near the mouth that the east (side) profile does not have. NEXT: re-file a corrected south-facing job (and check north for the same defect) that matches the east profile's mouth/head treatment -- no claws near the mouth -- keeping the approved two-tail/javelin-needle design otherwise. Do not wire any facing until the corrected south (and north, if it has the same issue) lands and gets a look.
ownerSaid: It's close. The tails are fine. But the south facing one has claws near the mouth. The side profile does not.

title: Sea shores via a tile mutator: a land tile bordering a sea gets that sea's shore + water on its coast. Engine (MEASURED, RimSage): coast water comes from the LAND map biome's oceanDeep/ShallowTerrain, so today a map beside the Scald gets vanilla ocean. Tiles touching two seas need a pick rule (majority neighbour, or per-edge like TileMutatorWorker_MixedBiome's angle).
ownerSaid: It sounds like a tile mutator would be the true fix so long as no tile had two different kinds of sea touching it, correct? If so, that's our path.

title: Scald art wave 2: high-res lush restyle of the Scald set, 2-3 stack variants per item; shulla catch as a small pile of fish; landspeeder wreck redone with pawn-scale seats; steam catch machinery not blue-tinted and the vent visibly CAPPED.
ownerSaid: the art looks very simple compared to our other lucious high-res art. We should improve it. It would be superb for everything to have a few variants where possible too, so that the players have a superb experience in their stockpiles.

title: Design: Scald steam weather beautiful + interesting + deadly without protective gear; the boiling water's danger and the player's protections; natives (noohm, shulla...) immune to their own water (today they burn: terrain burnDamage hits every pawn, no protection or immunity wired).
ownerSaid: It's worth talking about how we can make the Scald steam weather really beautiful and interesting (and deadly without protective gear).

title: Salvage wreckage across the planet: wreck families (hulls, tanks, frames, speeders...) scattered in every biome, biome-appropriate weathering, deconstruct-for-salvage loot. Scald wrecks are the worked example.

title: Statue expansion: assess the statue-choice mod (patch vs own), RM statues with flame emergence points, Utinni god/culture statues, flame fuel via Sump / Helixian gas / manual refuel. The Steel Flame statuary art is a placeholder to replace.
ownerSaid: 1) assess the current statue-art choice expansion mod to see if we should just patch in our own art or make our own, 2) render additional art for RimMandrake that we'd like to have (that happens to have invisible points where flames would make sense, thinking ahead) and put that in an extended art mod 3) Render specific Utinni art statues that feature the Utinni gods and other cultural specifics to the SW Utinni experience to expand that list. Then we'd tie that in to the Sump mod, the Helixian gas mod (if that's present instead or in addition), or manual refueling if not.

text: Protection ladder ruled: boil-suit via Industrial research; advanced vacsuit-types also protect; the Royal Rind (from the greatbole's fruit — no def by that name exists in src/ or design/ as of 2026-09-25) is a protection source to design.
ownerSaid: Industrial research for a boil-suit, but advanced vacsuit-types should be able to handle it too. And then there's the Royal Rind from the fruit of the great Bole.

text: Scope ruled: TWO mods, in order — (1) Utinni-culture statues (ideoligion ThingStyleDef/StyleCategoryDef route per statue_expansion_assessment.md), (2) Flame statues (own defs, flame emergence points, Sump-gas manual refuel first; replaces placeholder RM_FlameStatuary).
